summary_1line: Sita defiantly rejects Ravana, invoking Rama’s power and virtue, and Ravana threatens to kill and eat her if she refuses him within twelve months.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sita places a blade of grass between herself and Ravana while standing pale yet resolute before the towering demon king.
Ravana, crowned and fearsome, leans toward the captive Sita in the grove as she denounces him and invokes Rama’s coming wrath.
Sita, surrounded by grim titan women in the Ashoka grove, declares Rama’s arrows will rain down and destroy Lanka.
